editorial:
When your child gets sick, everything else stops. That is the heart of this emotional family drama. You follow Christy, a devoted mom who refuses to give up when her 10-year-old daughter Anna is diagnosed with a rare, incurable disease. The story pulls you into hospital rooms, late-night worries, and a mother's fierce fight for answers. It is heavy but hopeful, with a warm, faith-filled tone that never feels preachy. You will feel the family's pain, but also their love and strength.

The acting is the real standout here. Jennifer Garner carries the film with raw, believable emotion, and the young actress playing Anna is wonderful. The pacing is steady, though some scenes feel a bit slow. The pros: strong performances, touching message, and a satisfying payoff. The cons: it can be emotionally draining and a little predictable. If you enjoy uplifting true stories, this is for you. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Anna falls three stories from a tree and is rushed to the hospital. Doctors expect the worst, but she survives with no serious injuries. Even more surprising, her incurable disease suddenly goes into remission. Medical specialists cannot explain it. The family sees it as a miracle, and their community is inspired. Anna returns home healthy, and Christy's faith is restored. The film ends on a hopeful note with the family together and grateful.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves uplifting true stories and family dramas.
